name: Nasi Chat – Click to Connect
author: Peter Kagunda

sections.description:
Nasi Chat – Click to Connect adds a customizable floating WhatsApp button to your WordPress site, backed by a modern admin dashboard themed around WhatsApp green.

Your visitors would rather tap a button and talk to a real person than fill in a contact form and wait. Nasi Chat makes that a one-click job.

Features

  • Floating WhatsApp button with customizable position, size, color and animation
  • Custom uploaded icon support
  • Chat bubble tooltip with configurable delay
  • Multi-agent / department routing panel (names, job titles, photos and numbers)
  • Business hours scheduler with per-day open/close times and timezone support
  • Offline behavior: show a custom message or hide the button entirely
  • Device targeting (desktop only / mobile only / all)
  • Page and post include/exclude display rules
  • Built-in click analytics with a visual chart, no external service required
  • Optional Google Analytics (gtag) event tracking
  • Fully translatable, WPCS-compliant, and built with security best practices (sanitized input, escaped output, nonce-protected AJAX)

Want more? Upgrade to Nasi Chat Pro

Get Nasi Chat Pro is a paid add-on that turns the button into a complete customer conversation tool:

  • Per-agent online/offline status with “Back Mon 8:00 am” messages
  • Custom weekly hours and timezone for every team member
  • Full brand colour customisation, corner radius, panel width and photo shape
  • Multilingual support for WPML and Polylang
  • Telegram, Messenger, SMS and Email buttons beside WhatsApp
  • Pre-chat lead capture form with optional GDPR consent and spam protection
  • Lead management dashboard, CSV export and email notifications
  • Signed HMAC-SHA256 webhooks for Zapier, Make and your CRM
  • Chat shortcodes to place the chat box or a button anywhere

Nasi Chat Pro works as an add-on to this free plugin and is sold separately on peterkagunda.com. It is not distributed through WordPress.org.

Upgrade to Nasi Chat Pro | Read the Pro documentation

Free vs Pro

  • Floating WhatsApp button – Free and Pro
  • Multiple agents – Free and Pro
  • Business hours – Free and Pro
  • Click analytics – Free and Pro
  • Per-agent availability – Pro
  • Advanced colour customisation – Pro
  • Multilingual support – Pro
  • Telegram, Messenger, SMS and email buttons – Pro
  • Pre-chat lead capture, leads dashboard, CSV export, email notifications – Pro
  • Signed webhooks and chat shortcodes – Pro
sections.installation:
1. Upload the nasi-chat-click-to-connect folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install it from Plugins > Add New.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Nasi Chat in the admin menu to configure your number and settings.
sections.faq:
Does this require a WhatsApp Business account?

No, it works with any WhatsApp-enabled phone number using the standard wa.me deep link.

Can I show different numbers on different pages?

Yes – enable Multi-Agent Routing and add agents, or use the page display rules to control where the button appears.

Is there a Pro version?

Yes. Nasi Chat Pro adds per-agent availability, brand colours, multilingual support, extra channels (Telegram, Messenger, SMS, email), a pre-chat lead form with a leads dashboard, CSV export, email notifications, signed webhooks and shortcodes. It needs this free plugin to be installed and active.

How do I upgrade to Pro?

Buy a license at https://peterkagunda.com/product/nasi-chat-pro/, install the Pro add-on alongside this plugin, then enter your license key under Nasi Chat Pro in your WordPress admin. Step-by-step instructions are in the Pro documentation.

Will I lose my settings if I upgrade?

No. Your agents, hours and settings stay in this free plugin. Pro adds to them.
